connector.name: Zyla API Hub
connector.registryDescription: Discover and call 10,000+ production APIs from one MCP server. Pay-per-call billing for AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.zylalabs.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.zylalabs, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer YOUR_ZYLA_API_KEY — optional for discovery tools (search_catalog, get_api_info, browse_catalog, list_categories, register); required for call_api and account tools. Get a key with the register tool or at https://zylalabs.com/agents/connect
